purpose: Teach: のどか/ぶつぶつ/さぞかし/めでたく/ごろごろ/なつかしい/あてはまる/かわいらしい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの田舎は本当にのどかな所だったわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's countryside really is such a peaceful place, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic reminiscence. Soft opening, like remembering something good. Gentle pace, almost drifting. Voice settles into quiet appreciation at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが朝からぶつぶつ何か言ってらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's been muttering something to himself since this morning.
lines.style: Quiet observation, gently curious. Not accusing — noticing. Small, steady voice. Slight hesitation before 'something,' like he's not quite sure what the thing is.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃん、合格を知ったらさぞかし喜ばれるわね
lines.en: Sho, when Grandpa hears about the pass, he's going to be so happy.
lines.style: Bright, present warmth. Quicker pace now — anticipation lifting her tone. Light emphasis on 'so happy.' Clear eye-contact in the voice. Genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、メイ姉さんがめでたく結婚なさるんだって
lines.en: Mom, Mei-nee is going to get married!
lines.style: Quick, genuine excitement — not performed. Light emphasis on the marriage news. Small voice with genuine delight threaded through it. Eagerness to share, not to impress.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、週末はお家でごろごろしてばかりじゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't just laze around the house all weekend, you know.
lines.style: Gentle firmness without edge. Clear directive but warm underneath. Patient — this is something she's said before. Not raising her voice, but expecting him to hear her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの古いお写真、なつかしい気持ちになるね
lines.en: Mom, looking at Grandpa's old photos makes me feel nostalgic.
lines.style: Soft, reaching into a feeling. Quiet and a little vulnerable — looking for her to understand the bittersweet. Trailing off slightly at the end, like he's holding something tender.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、その模範解答が翔くんにあてはまるとは限らないわよ
lines.en: Sho, that model answer doesn't necessarily apply to you.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful. She's redirecting gently — not dismissing, protecting. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'you,' like she's making a point that matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達の妹さん、かわいらしい子だったよ
lines.en: Mom, my friend's little sister is really cute.
lines.style: Soft, a little uncertain in the sweetness — checking himself. Quiet pride in noticing something good. Small genuine laugh threading through. Not bragging, just sharing something he noticed.
